required_legal_controls.control: Documented risk analysis for the Edge IPC PHI workload.
Risk management measures approved for the Edge IPC PHI workload.
Information system activity review and audit-log review process documented.
Named security official or equivalent accountable owner approved.
Workforce authorization, clearance, and termination controls approved.
Information access management and minimum-role access controls approved.
Security awareness, malicious software, login monitoring, and password management program approved.
Security incident response, mitigation, and documentation procedure approved.
Backup, disaster recovery, emergency mode, and contingency plan approved.
Periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation procedure approved.
Business associate contract or equivalent satisfactory assurance executed.
Facility access controls for Edge IPC location approved.
Workstation use and workstation security controls approved.
Device and media controls for receipt, removal, disposal, reuse, accountability, and backup approved.
Technical access control, unique identity, emergency access, logoff, and encryption controls approved.
Audit control mechanisms for systems containing or using ePHI approved.
Integrity controls against improper ePHI alteration or destruction approved.
Person or entity authentication controls approved.
Transmission security, integrity controls, and encryption controls approved.
Policies, procedures, documentation retention, availability, and update process approved.
Permitted or required PHI use/disclosure basis approved for the workload purpose.
Minimum necessary policy and dataset limitation approved.
Authorization, consent, waiver, or other approved permission basis documented.
Breach assessment and notification procedure approved.
